messages:
nora: Hey team, heads up — I have a flight + keynote on Thu 09:00-13:00 PST and won't be reachable for primary paging during that window. Can someone take primary for that slot? I can still be secondary before/after. :airplane: :hourglass_flowing_sand:

oncall-bot: Reminder: please propose swaps at least 24h in advance per runbook → https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall-swap

samir: I can take primary for that block. Confirming I can be on pager and Slack from 09:00-13:00 PST. Will set my phone to bypass DND. :+1:

chris: I can float as secondary if needed. If anything big fires and I get pulled into primary, ping me on call + mobile.

maria: FYI yesterday we had two P1-style pagers during that window in another region, so watch the latency alert noise. Suggest setting the canary fallback to dedicated-01 for anything ramping. Putting runbook links: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/pg-pagers and https://redwood.internal/playbooks/latency-spike

incident-bot: Past 7d summary for prim=eu-night: 3 high pagers, 12 medium, avg MTTR 28m. Recent incidents: /incidents/2026-02-14-embed-regression (customers affected: 4).

nora: Thanks Samir — can you reply here after you flip the schedule so we have an audit trail? Prefer to do the swap using the rota tool so rotations don't get out of sync. CLI snippet:```bash
# grant primary for Thu 09-13 PST to samir
curl -X POST https://oncall.redwood.internal/api/v1/swap \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ROTATETOKEN' \
  -d '{"from":"nora","to":"samir","start":"2026-03-19T09:00:00-08:00","end":"2026-03-19T13:00:00-08:00","reason":"keynote flight"}'
```

samir: Done — I created the swap and got a 200. Event ID: swap_20260319_001. Also added a calendar invite to the oncall calendar for visibility: https://calendar.redwood/internal/oncall/2026-03-19-samir-primary.

nora: Confirmed, saw the swap event and calendar. Thank you! Two quick asks: 1) If any latency pagers hit, please follow the rapid-restart path in the runbook (sequence B) before escalating. 2) If it's an embedding regression, tag @ml-evals and ping me on slack DM (I'll try to monitor but might be offline).

maria: Noted. Samir — when you take primary, please check the kv-cache health dashboard first thing: https://observability.redwood/kv-cache?time=now-15m. If miss rate > 8% open a ticket with infra and notify chris.

samir: Will do an immediate health check at 08:55 PST and post results here.

chris: Also adding this quick escalation cheat: if customers > 10 impact, we auto page SRE lead + product oncall. Run the quick audit script:```bash
/redwood/tools/oncall-audit --window=15m --metrics=customer_impact,latency,errors
```

samir: 08:55 check: KV miss 4.2%, token throughput nominal, no active pagers. Screenshot posted to #eng-oncall-attachments. Ready to accept primary at 09:00 PST.

nora: Appreciate it. I'll leave my phone on but will defer primary to you. Marking this thread as confirmation. :white_check_mark:
